subject: PixelSoft outage review & remediation sign-off
messages:
From: Aditi Shah <aditi@pixelsoft.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, PixelSoft SRE Team <sre@pixelsoft.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 21:20:00 +0000
Subject: PixelSoft production: elevated latency + 502s (urgent)

Vivek / Kimberly —

We had a significant degradation in our checkout flow beginning ~21:12 UTC. Customers saw 8–12x latency for tokenization and a spike in 502 responses from Redwood endpoints. This has impacted about 17% of checkout attempts (we ingest per-request call ids in our logs). Our SREs captured the traces and we've attached the preliminary traces.

Key ask: can you confirm whether this was a serving-side regression or a capacity routing issue? We have a marketing launch tomorrow US morning and need clarity and a commitment on remediation and credits.

Attached: pixelsoft_traces_20270619.zip (logs + spans)

—Aditi
Aditi Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, PixelSoft
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi@pixelsoft.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 22:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PixelSoft production: elevated latency + 502s (urgent)

Thanks for the alert and the traces, Aditi — we see your spans. I’m opening an internal bridge now and looping in our SRE lead. We will surface a preliminary cause within 4 hours and a mitigation plan by EOD.

Immediate next steps:
- I’m escalating to our infrastructure on-call and will confirm whether there was a hardware or routing anomaly.
- Kimberly will coordinate a short mitigation window if we need to re-route traffic or apply a temporary model variant.

I’ll keep you updated on the bridge link (posting shortly).

Vivek Kulkarni
Head, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 01:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PixelSoft production: elevated latency + 502s (urgent)

On internal bridge — quick summary from infra team: between 21:10–21:30 UTC we had a scheduling regression on a subset of Dedicated pods that caused request queues to spike while autoscaler probes lagged behind for ~6 minutes. That produced tokenization timeouts for long-input requests and intermittent 502s when the frontend timed out.

Root cause (prelim): a recent kernel param tweak combined with an optimized batching path changed slot assignment under load in 2 GPU pools. The change rolled to Dedicated pools on 2027-06-19 20:55 UTC.

Immediate mitigations applied (20:50–21:40 UTC):
- Rollback of the kernel param to previous value (applied at 21:25 UTC)
- Force-evict mis-assigned pods and rebalance traffic to healthy pools
- Enabled temporary conservative autoscaler thresholds for the affected pools

Customer impact window: ~21:12–21:28 UTC (est). We saw peak 502 rate ~6% and median tokenization latency increase from 120ms to 950ms for large payloads.

I’ll follow up with a formal RCA doc and a list of corrective actions.

—Jonas
Director, Serving Runtime Engineering
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi@pixelsoft.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@pixelsoft.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:35:00 +0000
Subject: PixelSoft: RCA, remediation actions & proposed credits

Aditi / Tom —

Thanks again for patience while we closed the loop. Attached is our formal RCA (pixelsoft_rca_v1.pdf) and an operational runbook (mitigation_runbook.xlsx) that describes the short-term and medium-term fixes, ownership, and expected completion dates. Summary below: 

Executive summary:
- Cause: a kernel parameter tweak that altered GPU scheduling heuristics in two Dedicated pools, causing transient queue build-up and request timeouts for large/long-running tokenization requests. The change was included in a control-plane rollout that began 2027-06-19 20:55 UTC.
- Impact window: ~2027-06-19 21:12–21:28 UTC. Peak customer-facing 502s ~6% and median latency for affected requests increased to ~950ms.
- Remediation applied: immediate rollback (21:25 UTC), forced pod rebalance, and conservative autoscaler thresholds.

Corrective actions and timeline (high level):
1) Configuration rollback + deployment gating: Completed (owner: Jonas) — done 2027-06-19.
2) Autoscaler tuning and early-warning telemetry: In progress (owner: Neha) — targeted complete 2027-06-24.
3) Regression prevention: add CI smoke tests for scheduling heuristics and a canary rollout policy for kernel params (owner: Jonas/Infra) — target 2027-07-08.
4) Customer-side mitigation: small-variant model to route large tokenization requests as short-term fallback (owner: Kimberly) — target 2027-06-22.

Compensation proposal: We propose a one-time credit equivalent to 7 days of average token usage during the impacted window. Attached is a proposed SLA credit agreement draft (proposed_sla_credit_agreement.pdf).

Action items for PixelSoft:
- Please review the RCA and runbook and confirm acceptance of remediation timeline by EOD Tue 2027-06-22 so we can prioritize the canary and autoscaler work.
- If you need an earlier change freeze window for your launch, propose a window and Kimberly will coordinate.

If this summary looks good I’ll escalate for exec sign-off on the credit and we’ll schedule a 30-minute readout with your leadership.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@pixelsoft.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditi Shah <aditi@pixelsoft.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PixelSoft: RCA, remediation actions & proposed credits

Vivek — thanks for the rapid investigation and clear plan. We accept the RCA and the proposed 7-day credit. Two quick asks before exec sign-off:

1) Can you share the telemetry dashboard we'll use to confirm autoscaler behavior post-change? We want access to a live view during our launch window.
2) For the canary policy, we need a rollback play that includes both routing and a specific contact list for on-call handoff. Can Kimberly/Neha include that in the runbook?

If you can get those two items added by EOD Tue we’ll be comfortable with sign-off and will schedule the readout.

—Tom
Director of Engineering, PixelSoft
